note: Every model this runtime may use must have its own entry, with all four billing classes. A missing or unverified entry fails closed: no paid request runs and no 'cost enforced' badge is shown.

capability_notes.supports_forced_tool_use: Whether this model accepts tool_choice {"type": "any"}. An ACTION turn has no legal prose outcome, so CreditProbe requires a tool call on one. Most models accept this; a few answer 400, and for those set it to false. Default true: a model that refuses it is detected on the first rejection, the parameter is dropped for the rest of that run, and the call report says so.
capability_notes.supports_effort_control: Whether this model accepts output_config.effort. CreditProbe sends a LOW effort on action turns and a higher one on the answer, because choosing the next action is a decision and the analysis itself runs in DuckDB. Default false: a model that does not know the parameter REJECTS the request rather than ignoring it, and a run failing closed over a latency optimisation would be worse than the latency. Set it to true once you have confirmed your model accepts it.
